title: Morning Race Advisory · 49er
problem: Turn forecast and stored observations into pre-race tactical advice
example_input: 49er · Course A · Cabrillo. Forecast: WSW 12 kts building to 18. Coach recalls sea breeze shift left ~10° around 10:00 last October.
evidence_1: Weather station SMO 06:15: WSW 12 kts gusting 15 kts — building to 18 kts by 11:30.
evidence_2: Coach A (Oct 2025): sea breeze shifted left 8–12° between 09:45 and 10:15 on Course A. Right start, left layline finish.
evidence_3: Pattern: 7 of 9 sessions with similar morning WSW conditions showed left rotation before noon on Course A.
recommendation: Start right for initial WSW pressure. Expect 8–12° left rotation around 10:00 — tack for the shift. Second beat: left layline favored.
next_step: Monitor wind every 15 min from 09:30. Log first-beat position and tack timing after the race via voice note.

title: Afternoon Advisory · Nacra 17
problem: Prepare for thermal hole risk based on yesterday's observation and today's forecast
example_input: Nacra 17 · Course B · Long Beach. Racing at 14:00. Yesterday: thermal drop from 16 to 4 kts for 22 min at 13:32.
evidence_1: Forecast: SSW 16 kts at 13:00. Thermal risk window 13:00–14:30 based on land/sea ΔT = 7 °C.
evidence_2: Coach B (yesterday): thermal at 13:32 — pressure dropped 16→4 kts for 22 min. Boats high and right recovered first.
evidence_3: Pattern: 4 of 5 similar thermal-risk days show pressure recovery starting from western course boundary.
recommendation: High thermal-hole risk at start time. Conservative start advised. If aggressive: position high-right. Brief crew on potential 15–25 min below foiling threshold.
next_step: Discuss thermal tactics in tonight's team meeting. Log start-line conditions before race via voice note.
